n-all.text: Same rules as the polish canvas: one loud thing per page, heavy widened headings, big numerals, radii 48 / 32 / 20, tonal blocks instead of dividers. Every board is a fluid page: it wraps to one column on a phone and nothing is removed.

n-cloud.text: Off by default and never set up by itself. The sign-in belongs to the owner and happens on the provider's own page; the tunnel's credential never appears in the app. Pause and Remove need the two keys.

n-updates.text: Nothing here runs by itself. Rollback, USB install and recovery all need the two-key confirmation.
